name: @ruvector/tiny-dancer-wasm
description: WebAssembly bindings for Tiny Dancer - FastGRNN neural inference for AI routing in browsers

scripts.build: node init && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg
scripts.build:node: node init && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node
scripts.build:bundler: node init && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg-bundler
